name: Stormscribe
lore: A wizard who reads the weather in the orchard clock towers.

primary.name: Spark Script
primary.description: Tap for a 19-damage spark, or hold 0.85s for a 34.2-damage ball lightning. Full charge shocks nearby enemies for 4 damage every 0.25s while travelling; at most three shocks per target per cast.

special.name: Thunderfall
special.description: Hold Space to show and position Thunderfall’s landing circle. Release to launch the storm orb for 55 area damage. Enemies hit are stunned for 2 seconds.

passive: Storm Aura: you and allied heroes within 160 units move 15% faster while your passive is unlocked. Multiple Storm Auras do not stack.

technique.name: Rolling Thunder
technique.description: Thunderfall covers 30% more radius for 20% less damage.

final_technique.name: Forked Horizons
final_technique.description: Two lightning forks bend out and return, 16 damage per leg. Replaces automatic multi-target bolts with a manually aimed route.

attack.name: Forked Horizons
attack.description: Two lightning forks bend out and return, 16 damage per leg. Replaces automatic multi-target bolts with a manually aimed route.
